import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long f, c;
        Edge(int u, int v, long f, long c) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        List<Edge> E;
        List<Integer>[] G;
        int[] lvl;
        int[] ptr;
        int source, sink;
        int MAX_VER;

        FlowNetwork(int maxVer) {
            MAX_VER = maxVer;
            E = new ArrayList<>();
            G = new List[MAX_VER];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VER; ++i) {
                G[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            lvl = new int[MAX_VER];
            ptr = new int[MAX_VER];
        }

        void reset() {
            E.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VER; ++i) {
                G[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void link(int u, int v, long cap) {
            E.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
            E.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            G[u].add(E.size() - 2);
            G[v].add(E.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean levelGraph() {
            Arrays.fill(lvl, -1);
            Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
            Q.offer(source);
            lvl[source] = 0;

            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = Q.poll();
                for (int idx : G[u]) {
                    Edge e = E.get(idx);
                    if (e.c > e.f && lvl[e.v] == -1) {
                        lvl[e.v] = lvl[u] + 1;
                        Q.offer(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return lvl[sink] != -1;
        }

        long augment(int u, long bottleneck) {
            if (u == sink || bottleneck == 0) return bottleneck;
            long pushed = 0;
            for (; ptr[u] < G[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
                int idx = G[u].get(ptr[u]);
                Edge e = E.get(idx);
                if (lvl[e.v] == lvl[u] + 1 && e.c > e.f) {
                    long flow = augment(e.v, Math.min(bottleneck, e.c - e.f));
                    if (flow > 0) {
                        e.f += flow;
                        E.get(idx ^ 1).f -= flow;
                        pushed += flow;
                        bottleneck -= flow;
                        if (bottleneck == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return pushed;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long total = 0;
            while (levelGraph()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long flow;
                while ((flow = augment(source, Long.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                    total += flow;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static FlowNetwork net;
    static char[][] board1 = new char[14][14];
    static char[][] board2 = new char[14][14];
    static boolean[][] visGrid = new boolean[14][14];
    static int[][] timeGrid = new int[14][14];
    static int sizeN, steps;
    static int[] finalNode = new int[103];

    static void propagate(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(timeGrid[i], 111);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        timeGrid[x][y] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{x, y, 0});

        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1], d = cell[2];
            if (visGrid[r][c]) continue;
            visGrid[r][c] = true;
            timeGrid[r][c] = d;

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dx[i], nc = c + dy[i];
                if (nr >= 1 && nr <= sizeN && nc >= 1 && nc <= sizeN &&
                    !visGrid[nr][nc] && board1[nr][nc] != 'Y') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc, d + 1});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int encode(int t, int r, int c) {
        return t * sizeN * sizeN + (r - 1) * sizeN + c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        sizeN = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        steps = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            board1[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            board2[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        net = new FlowNetwork(7100);
        net.source = 0;
        net.sink = 7100 - 2;

        int startR = 0, startC = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= sizeN; ++j) {
                if (board1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    startR = i;
                    startC = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN * sizeN; ++i) {
            finalNode[i] = 7100 - 3 - (sizeN * sizeN - i);
        }

        propagate(startR, startC);

        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= sizeN; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(board1[i][j])) {
                    net.link(net.source, encode(0, i, j), board1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(board2[i][j])) {
                    net.link(finalNode[encode(0, i, j)], net.sink, board2[i][j] - '0');
                }
                net.link(encode(0, i, j), finalNode[encode(0, i, j)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        for (int t = 1; t <= steps; ++t) {
            for (int r = 1; r <= sizeN; ++r) {
                for (int c = 1; c <= sizeN; ++c) {
                    if (board1[r][c] == 'Y' || board1[r][c] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int nr = r + dx[k], nc = c + dy[k];
                        if (nr >= 1 && nr <= sizeN && nc >= 1 && nc <= sizeN &&
                            board1[nr][nc] != 'Y' && board1[nr][nc] != 'Z' &&
                            timeGrid[r][c] >= t && timeGrid[nr][nc] >= t) {
                            net.link(encode(t - 1, nr, nc), encode(t, r, c), Long.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                    net.link(encode(t, r, c), finalNode[encode(0, r, c)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(net.maxFlow());
    }
}
